art_direction: contemporary editorial keynote: bright fresh paper, assertive photographic crops and confident Chinese serif headlines; visual character comes from scale, alignment and a clear image-text relationship
palette: clean warm paper #F4F0E7 dominant, carbon #20201E text, oxblood #9C302B accent; muted marine #344A5A only when a diagram needs a second series
typography: Chinese Song-style serif with sturdy readable hairlines for headlines; neutral Chinese sans serif for captions, body and diagrams; deliberate contrast between headline and annotation size
materials: fresh uncoated paper with almost imperceptible fiber, sharp ink edges and richly detailed photography; collage uses a few purposeful cuts and restrained contact shadows
text_layout: one concise headline with only essential supplied labels, body statements or values; place type on a clean paper field with deliberate semantic line breaks
contrast: carbon text on warm paper; reversed paper-white text only on a solid dark ink field; photographs, grain and rules stay outside letterforms
avoid: fake magazine masthead or issue metadata

magazine-cover.label: 裁切杂志封面
magazine-cover.summary: 让大幅裁切摄影与宋体标题形成张力
magazine-cover.composition: a tall editorial photograph occupies the visual zone with an assertive off-center crop; a two- or three-line serif headline anchors the paper margin, aligned to a clean shared baseline
magazine-cover.imagery: one content-relevant photograph with a confident hard crop and natural color; clean paper margin and one oxblood accent, no blurred fade into the text field

title_treatment.weight: serif conclusion with deliberate line breaks

requirements: photographic subject and headline form distinct focal areas
no invented cover lines, masthead or issue number
default to one concise title and essential supplied content; no automatic explanatory subtitle, eyebrow or footer microcopy

editorial-statement.label: 纸面论点
editorial-statement.summary: 用明显的字级差与留白突出一句判断
editorial-statement.composition: an editorial type composition with one prominent serif statement and ample clean paper around the statement; a short rule aligns the block, leaving a broad unprinted region
editorial-statement.imagery: clean warm paper and crisp ink; an optional small image detail only if the content needs it
requirements: one sentence or short text cluster gets the most visual weight
use whitespace as an active element
default to one concise title and essential supplied content; no automatic explanatory subtitle, eyebrow or footer microcopy
avoid: quote attribution not present in exact_text

documentary-hero.label: 摄影跨页
documentary-hero.summary: 主图保留现场细节，短图注落在干净纸边
documentary-hero.composition: a dominant documentary photograph with a purposeful crop and a narrow clean paper caption margin; image scale exceeds text scale
documentary-hero.imagery: photorealistic observed subject, natural exposure, visible material detail and credible surroundings; no staged corporate pose

title_treatment.weight: restrained sans caption or short serif claim

requirements: subject must not cross the text-safe zone
image carries the narrative without invented labels
default to one concise title and essential supplied content; no automatic explanatory subtitle, eyebrow or footer microcopy

profile-feature.label: 人物专访
profile-feature.summary: 以人物的视线或动作连接旁边的引文
profile-feature.composition: a close portrait or working-hand detail faces into an adjacent serif quote field; use a clean gutter and a small sans attribution only when supplied
profile-feature.imagery: natural-light portrait or supplied identity reference; preserve skin, fabric and hand texture without beauty retouching

title_treatment.weight: quote-led serif with attribution only when supplied

requirements: do not invent name, role or attribution
keep the face and text in separate quiet regions
default to one concise title and essential supplied content; no automatic explanatory subtitle, eyebrow or footer microcopy

editorial-diagram.label: 印刷图解
editorial-diagram.summary: 用平面墨线和直接标注解释关系与数值
editorial-diagram.composition: one flat editorial diagram on clean paper, with aligned sans labels and one oxblood emphasis; choose structure from the supplied relationship or data
editorial-diagram.imagery: flat print geometry with clear line hierarchy, solid oxblood emphasis and substantial direct labels; meaningful paper-cut shapes for qualitative ideas, proportional flat marks for numbers

title_treatment.weight: short conclusion integrated with the diagram

requirements: all labels and numbers are supplied
geometry preserves data proportions; printed texture never obscures labels
default to one concise title and essential supplied content; no automatic explanatory subtitle, eyebrow or footer microcopy

comparison-spread.label: 编辑对照
comparison-spread.summary: 同尺度图片或图解并置，留出共同的阅读基线
comparison-spread.composition: paired photographs or diagrams aligned on a shared baseline, separated by a clean paper gutter; labels use matching positions and type size
comparison-spread.imagery: matched crops or flat ink diagrams, carbon labels and one shared oxblood rule; keep exposure comparable when judging visual differences

title_treatment.weight: short comparison conclusion, not a banner

requirements: both columns use the same comparison dimension
preserve a clear gutter
default to one concise title and essential supplied content; no automatic explanatory subtitle, eyebrow or footer microcopy
avoid: comparison labels invented by the model

collage-scene.label: 纸面拼贴
collage-scene.summary: 用少量摄影切片组成一个清楚的编辑意象
collage-scene.composition: one dominant editorial montage assembled from a few content-relevant fragments at contrasting scales; preserve a broad clean copy margin
collage-scene.imagery: paper collage of cut photographic fragments, crisp cut edges and light contact shadows; one oxblood flat form may bind the composition
requirements: metaphor must support the supplied claim
no collage fragment may introduce readable extra text
default to one concise title and essential supplied content; no automatic explanatory subtitle, eyebrow or footer microcopy
